subtopic: API Rate Limiting (Token Bucket, Leaky Bucket)
question_text: Why does the Fixed Window Counter rate-limiting algorithm suffer from the 'Boundary Burst' vulnerability?

options.text: It consumes O(N) memory per client
A client can send 100% of its quota at the very end of window 1 and another 100% at the immediate start of window 2, doubling permitted traffic over a 1-window span
It requires cryptographic hashing of client IPs
It causes high CPU usage during clock synchronization

answer_explanation: In a 100 req/minute limit, sending 100 requests at 00:59 and 100 requests at 01:01 yields 200 requests in 2 seconds, potentially overwhelming downstream services.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: B. Rationale: In a 100 req/minute limit, sending 100 requests at 00:59 and 100 requests at 01:01 yields 200 requests in 2 seconds, potentially overwhelming downstream services.
